## Walkthrough Two Tekton pipeline configuration files were updated to use a newer OpenShift release artifact (version 4.21.10 instead of 4.21.0-ec.1), with corresponding patch-version parameter adjustments. The `ecosystem-cert-preflight-checks` task was removed from both pipelines. ## Changes |Cohort / File(s)|Summary| |---|---| |**Tekton Pipeline Configuration**
`.tekton/ove-ui-iso-pull-request.yaml`, `.tekton/ove-ui-iso-push.yaml`|Updated `release-value` parameter to `quay.io/openshift-release-dev/ocp-release:4.21.10-x86_64` and `patch-version` from `"0"` to `"10"`. Removed `ecosystem-cert-preflight-checks` matrix task and its conditional execution logic.| ## Estimated code review effort 🎯 2 (Simple) | ⏱️ ~8 minutes
🚥 Pre-merge checks | ✅ 10
✅ Passed checks (10 passed) | Check name | Status | Explanation | | :----------------------------------------------: | :------- | :----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- | | Docstring Coverage | ✅ Passed | No functions found in the changed files to evaluate docstring coverage. Skipping docstring coverage check. | | Stable And Deterministic Test Names | ✅ Passed | PR modifies only Tekton pipeline YAML files, not Ginkgo test files. Custom check applies only to Ginkgo test declarations in Go test files. | | Test Structure And Quality | ✅ Passed | This PR contains no changes to Ginkgo test code. The pull request only modifies Tekton pipeline configuration files (.tekton/ove-ui-iso-pull-request.yaml and .tekton/ove-ui-iso-push.yaml), which are YAML-based infrastructure definitions. Although the repository contains Ginkgo test files (tools/agent_tui/*_test.go), none of these test files were modified by this PR. The custom check requirements for test structure, setup/cleanup patterns, timeouts, and assertion messages are not applicable since no test code changes are present. | | Microshift Test Compatibility | ✅ Passed | This check is not applicable. The PR only modifies Tekton pipeline configuration YAML files and does not add any new Ginkgo e2e tests. | | Single Node Openshift (Sno) Test Compatibility | ✅ Passed | This PR does not add any new Ginkgo e2e tests. Changes are limited to Tekton pipeline YAML files updating build parameters and removing a preflight-checks task. | | Topology-Aware Scheduling Compatibility | ✅ Passed | PR modifies only Tekton PipelineRun CI/CD manifests, not cluster deployment manifests or operator code. No scheduling constraints introduced. | | Ote Binary Stdout Contract | ✅ Passed | PR modifies only Tekton pipeline YAML configuration files, not source code or binary entry points, so OTE Binary Stdout Contract check is not applicable. | | Ipv6 And Disconnected Network Test Compatibility | ✅ Passed | This PR does not add any new Ginkgo e2e tests. The changes only modify Tekton pipeline YAML configuration files by updating release version parameters and removing a preflight checks task. Since the custom check specifically applies to when new Ginkgo e2e tests are added, this check is not applicable and passes by default. | | Description Check | ✅ Passed | Check skipped - CodeRabbit’s high-level summary is enabled. | | Title check | ✅ Passed | The title accurately reflects the main change: removing the ecosystem-cert-preflight-checks task from the Tekton pipelines, which aligns with the PR objective. |
✏️ Tip: You can configure your own custom pre-merge checks in the settings.
✨ Finishing Touches
🧪 Generate unit tests (beta) - [ ] Create PR with unit tests
